# TESS Program G09194

Title: Measuring The Impact Of Disk Truncation And Orbit-Orbit Alignment In Edge-On Binaries

PI: Oddo, Dominic - University Of New Mexico

Type: SMALL

Summary: This investigation adopts a "binary-centric" approach to characterize planets in separated stellar binaries. We will measure the planet suppression factor across separations of 30 800 AU and investigate orbit-orbit alignment. Using TESS Cycles 1 9, we will search for transits in a sample of "near-edge-on" and an additional sample of misaligned binaries. Comparing yields between these samples will constrain the mutual inclination distribution and the impact of disk truncation on planet occurrence. We expect to identify 10 20 new candidates, providing the first direct measurement of binary suppression&#8203; and delivering high-value targets for RV and JWST follow-up.
